newsitem.title: USA: Psychiatric Group Q2 div down.
newsitem.headline: Psychiatric Group Q2 div down.

text.p: American Health Properties Inc said Thursday the second quarter dividend for its Psychiatric Group Depositary Shares fell to $0.63 per share from $0.75.
The dividend is payable August 15, 1997 to shareholders of record August 1, 1997.
The Psychiatric Group Depositary Shares represent American Health's $52 million of investments in five psychiatric hospitals.
The financial performance of the psychiatric portfolio, as reflected by the depositary shares, was down significantly from the first quarter, American Health said.

Psychiatric Group funds from operations (FFO) for the second quarter dropped to $1.39 million, or $0.66 per depositary share, against $1.72 million, $0.82 per depositary share, in the first quarter, the release said.
American Health Properties Inc is a real estate investment trust with more than $650 million of investments in health care facilities located in 17 states.
